threshold_note: Self-calibrated at baseline time: the median top-1 hybrid score of the answerable questions in this run. A no_answer question counts as abstainable when its top-1 score falls below it.
note: The gateway eval gate (tools/gateway/gateway/evalgate.py) blocks promotion when the latest extended-latest report shows any gated metric more than epsilon below these values. Moving this baseline is a deliberate act: re-run with --emit-baseline.
